raw:
TABLET SONIFICATION — the inscription as waveform

gilgamesh_flood_tablet.jpg -> 682 wedge cells -> 72.3s audio

Mapping: wedge orientation class -> pitch
  horizontal 220.0Hz | vertical 277.2Hz | diag-up 329.6Hz | diag-down 392.0Hz
Depth score -> amplitude | secondary wedge -> fifth harmonic
Reading order: right-to-left (cuneiform ductus)

The formations are no longer silent — every cell is a tone,
every column a phrase, the whole tablet a 72-second chord
stream. Decrypt wave patterns: literal.
